title: Next-Gen GPUs Are Finally Ditching Proprietary Cables
deck: Hardware makers are quietly standardizing around a single, open power spec after years of melted connectors.
body: After years of melted connectors and bulky adapters, hardware makers are quietly standardizing around a single, open power spec.
For PC builders, this means cleaner cable management, safer power delivery, and no more hunting for third-party adapters.
pullQuote: “Reliability should never require a third-party adapter just to keep your graphics card from melting.”

title: Indie Studio Ships 60fps Open-World RPG Under 4GB
deck: Smart procedural textures prove modern games do not need 150GB installs to look sharp and run smoothly.
body: Smart procedural textures prove modern games do not need 150GB installs to look sharp and run smoothly.
The two-person dev team built custom compression tools that stream world geometry on the fly.
pullQuote: “In an industry obsessed with bloat, restraint has become the ultimate superpower.”
